from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company's 10-Q filing, sufficient to compute capital intensity ratio."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    revenue: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues amount")
    revenue_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of revenue: 'millions', 'thousands', etc.")
    investing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash used in/provided by investing activities (negative = used, positive = provided)")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of investing cash flow: 'millions', 'thousands', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered, e.g., '2025-03'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
